knowledge_devotion.name: Knowledge Devotion
knowledge_devotion.description: You use your study of monster anatomy and weaknesses to strike true in combat. Whenever you fight a creature, you gain an insight bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls against that creature type based on your Knowledge check result (15 or less: +1; 16-25: +2; 26-30: +3; 31-35: +4; 36 or more: +5).
